tasks.description: Add a shared command/help registry and first debugger-family aliases for `stack`, `source`, and `breakpoint`.
tasks.notes: Registry is now shared by shell help and TUI discovery; ADR 0026 landed.

tasks.description: Add frame-oriented stack inspection APIs and shell/TUI workflows on top of the current boundary-span view.
tasks.notes: `swat-api` now projects stack frames from boundary spans, and both shell and TUI use the shared frame model.

tasks.description: Add richer source listing and navigation workflows, including file-oriented discovery beyond event-scoped source lookup.
tasks.notes: `swat-api` now catalogs source files and direct file views, and both shell and TUI expose `source files` / `source view` workflows.

tasks.description: Deepen the `breakpoint` family into grouped views, richer metadata, and debugger-oriented inspection output.
tasks.notes: `swat-api` now projects shared breakpoint summaries/details/groups; `breakpoint list/show/groups` use that model while raw `triggers` stays compatible.

tasks.description: Add shared help/completion/history/discovery metadata across shell and TUI.
tasks.notes: Shared registry search/completion now drives shell `rustyline` completion/history, TUI command-mode tab/history, and `help search <needle>` discovery.

tasks.description: Add script/runtime wrappers for the first debugger command families on top of `swat-api`.
tasks.notes: `swat-script` now wraps stack/source/breakpoint workflows through `swat-api` for both frozen script contexts and live script sessions, without shell-only shortcuts.

tasks.description: Reconcile Milestone 1 docs, demos, and validation evidence until the milestone exit criteria are materially satisfied.
tasks.notes: Milestone 1 closeout note, refreshed command demo coverage, and green focused/full validation now document the command-ecology exit criteria.

tasks.description: Add grouped breakpoint definitions, reusable predicates, and richer stop-reason modeling.
tasks.notes: Named predicate libraries, user-defined breakpoint groups, and typed stop reasons now sit on the shared trigger substrate across `swat-control`, `swat-api`, and `swat-command`.

tasks.description: Add watchpoints for values, objects, resources, and lifecycle-aware load/time break conditions.
tasks.notes: `swat-control` now supports value-change watchpoints plus elapsed-time and lifecycle-gated load predicates over shared value observations, with ADR 0029 documenting the stateful model.

tasks.description: Expose advanced breakpoint/watchpoint management across shell, TUI, script, and public API.
tasks.notes: `swat-api` now projects typed watchpoint specs/details, shell and TUI share live breakpoint/watchpoint management, `swat-script` wraps the same mutation surface, and trigger persistence v4 preserves watchpoints.

tasks.description: Add typed frame/local/register inspection primitives for modern targets and shared APIs.
tasks.notes: `swat-api` now projects typed frame inspections with locals/registers from structured modern-target artifacts, shell and TUI expose `stack locals` / `stack registers`, and `swat-script` wraps the same frame-binding model.

tasks.description: Add typed patient/handle/resource/object inspection models and debugger-native presentations.
tasks.notes: Shared value/resolver/API layers now project typed patient/handle/resource/object models, and shell/TUI/script surfaces expose debugger-native inspection without changing `swat-core`.

tasks.description: Deepen expression/value/source/resolver traversals for debugger-native workflows rather than only event queries.
tasks.notes: Query fields now cover typed target entities and source lines, shared APIs project value history and source-function traversal, and shell/TUI/script surfaces expose the same debugger-native workflows.

tasks.description: Add package-oriented script loading and shared command metadata integration.
tasks.notes: Built-in script packages now autoload over the public API, and shell help/search/completion reuse the same package metadata.

tasks.description: Migrate the highest-value legacy Tcl command families onto the new runtime and help surface.
tasks.notes: Focus on stack/patient/process/object/source helpers first.

tasks.description: Expose PC/GEOS control and inspection through shared APIs, shell, TUI, and demos.
tasks.notes: Cover registers, memory, stack, patient, handle, and source flows.
